popupEnable.description: Label of the popup switch that shows or hides the toolbar.

panelTitleVideo.description: Title of the video download panel.

panelPin.description: Button that keeps the panel open.

panelUnpin.description: Button that releases a pinned panel and closes it.

comingSoon.description: Placeholder for features that are not implemented yet.

loading.description: Shown while panel content is loading.

retry.description: Button that retries loading panel content.

helpVideo.message: Download this video in the quality you choose.
helpVideo.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Video button.

helpMp3.message: Download the audio as MP3, optionally only part of it.
helpMp3.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the MP3 button.

helpThumbnail.message: Download the video thumbnail in different sizes.
helpThumbnail.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Thumbnail button.

helpSubtitles.message: Download subtitles as SRT, VTT or plain text.
helpSubtitles.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Subtitles button.

helpScreenshot.message: Save the current video frame as a PNG image.
helpScreenshot.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Screenshot button.

btnLink.description: Toolbar button name. Opens the copy link panel.

helpLink.message: Copy a short link to this video, optionally starting at the current time.
helpLink.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Link button.

panelTitleLink.description: Title of the copy link panel.

panelTitleMp3.description: Title of the MP3 download panel.

download.description: Primary button that starts a download.

downloadSaved.description: Shown after a file was saved to the browser's download folder.

downloadFailed.description: Error when the browser could not save a file.

thumbnailNone.message: No thumbnails were found for this video.
thumbnailNone.description: Thumbnail panel: no thumbnail size exists.

thumbnailMissing.message: This size is no longer available.
thumbnailMissing.description: Thumbnail panel: the chosen size does not exist.

screenshotSaved.description: Shown on the screenshot button after saving.

screenshotFailed.description: Shown on the screenshot button when the browser blocks capturing.

screenshotNoVideo.description: Shown on the screenshot button when there is no frame to capture.

subtitlesUploaded.description: Subtitles panel: group of subtitles uploaded by the creator.

subtitlesAuto.description: Subtitles panel: group of automatically generated subtitles.

subtitlesAutoBadge.description: Subtitles panel: label of the icon that marks auto-generated subtitles.

subtitlesNone.description: Subtitles panel: shown when the video has no subtitles.

subtitlesFormat.description: Subtitles panel: label of the format dropdown.

subtitlesDirectFailed.message: Couldn't download these subtitles directly from YouTube. Installing the helper program lets the extension use yt-dlp instead.
subtitlesDirectFailed.description: Subtitles panel: error when the direct download fails.

liveUnavailable.message: Live and upcoming videos can't be downloaded.
liveUnavailable.description: Download panels: shown for live and upcoming videos.

hostMissingTitle.description: Video and MP3 panels: heading when the helper program is not available.

hostMissingIntro.description: Video and MP3 panels: explanation before the list of components.

hostComponentHelper.description: Name of the native helper program component.

hostStatusUnreachable.description: Status of the helper program when it cannot be reached.

hostStatusUnknown.description: Status of yt-dlp or ffmpeg when the helper is not connected.

hostStepsTitleMac.description: Heading of the macOS installation steps.

hostStepsTitleWindows.description: Heading of the Windows installation steps.

hostStepsTitleOther.description: Heading of the installation steps on other systems.

hostStepPackagesWindows.message: Install the tools with winget in PowerShell:

hostStepScriptWindows.message: Download the helper and run its install script:

hostOtherOs.message: The helper program is available for macOS and Windows.
hostOtherOs.description: Shown on systems other than macOS and Windows.

hostInstallGuide.description: Link to the installation section of the README.

hostRecheck.description: Button that checks the helper connection again.

hostChecking.description: Shown while checking the helper connection.

hostComponentDeno.description: Name of the deno component (JavaScript runtime used by yt-dlp).

hostToolsMissingTitle.description: Video and MP3 panels: heading when the helper is connected but yt-dlp or ffmpeg is missing.

hostStatusMissing.description: Status of a tool that the helper could not find.

hostStatusFound.description: Status of an installed tool without a known version.

hostStatusVersion.description: Status of an installed tool with its version.

hostStepRecheckOnly.description: Last installation step when the helper is already installed.

hostDenoHint.message: deno is not installed. yt-dlp may miss some YouTube formats without it. Install it with:
hostDenoHint.description: Hint shown when only deno is missing.

clipTitle.description: Heading of the time range block in the video and MP3 panels.

clipSync.description: Switch: moving a handle seeks the player, and set-to-current-time buttons appear.

clipSetNow.description: Button that sets the start or end to the player's current time.

clipSlowHint.message: Cutting a part needs extra processing time.
clipSlowHint.description: One-time note shown when the time range is not the whole video.

qualityNone.description: Video panel: the format list is empty.

qualityMore.description: Video panel: shows WEBM and other formats.

qualityFewer.description: Video panel: hides formats other than MP4.

sizeApprox.description: Prefix of an estimated file size (followed by the size, e.g. ~147.1 MB).

mp3Bitrate.description: MP3 panel: label of the bitrate dropdown.

jobsLabel.description: Accessible label of the download list in a panel.

jobProcessing.description: Download state: merging, converting or cutting.

jobReveal.description: Button that shows the downloaded file in Finder or File Explorer.

errMissingTools.message: The helper, yt-dlp or ffmpeg is missing. See the installation guide.

errOutdated.message: YouTube has changed. Please update yt-dlp.
errOutdated.description: Download error: yt-dlp is outdated or YouTube asked for verification.

errLoginRequired.message: This video needs you to sign in. That isn't supported yet.

errVideoUnavailable.description: Download error: removed, private or blocked video.

errFormatUnavailable.message: This quality is no longer available. Try another one.
errFormatUnavailable.description: Download error: the chosen format does not exist.

errNoSubtitles.message: There are no subtitles in this language.

errNetwork.message: There was a network problem. Please try again.

errCannotWrite.message: Couldn't write to the download folder.
errCannotWrite.description: Download error: disk full or no permission.

errTooManyJobs.message: Too many downloads at the same time (up to 8).

updateRunning.description: Shown while yt-dlp is being updated.

updateUpToDate.message: yt-dlp is already up to date.
updateUpToDate.description: Shown when yt-dlp needs no update.

updateRunCommand.message: yt-dlp was installed with a package manager. Update it by running:
updateRunCommand.description: Shown with the command to update yt-dlp.

subtitlesViaHost.message: Downloading with yt-dlp instead, to your download folder.
subtitlesViaHost.description: Subtitles panel: the direct download failed and the helper is used.

notifyDoneTitle.description: Notification title. The message is the file name; clicking shows the file.

notifyFailedTitle.description: Notification title for a failed download.

optionsDownloadsDesc.message: Videos, MP3 and subtitles downloaded with yt-dlp are saved to the folder below. Thumbnails, screenshots and subtitles that the extension downloads directly go to the browser's own download location.
optionsDownloadsDesc.description: Settings page: explanation of the downloads section.

optionsConnection.description: Settings page: heading of the helper connection status.

optionsFolderDefault.description: Settings page: the default download folder.

optionsFolderDefaultUnknown.description: Settings page: the default download folder when the helper is not connected.

optionsFolderChoose.description: Settings page: opens the system folder picker.

optionsFolderReset.description: Settings page: goes back to the system Downloads folder.

optionsFolderUnsupported.message: Choosing a folder isn't supported on this system.
optionsFolderUnsupported.description: Settings page: pickFolder is not available.

optionsFiles.description: Settings page: heading of the file name and embed options.

optionsEmbed.message: Embed cover, chapters and video info

optionsEmbedDesc.message: Adds the thumbnail, title, channel, upload date, link and chapters to downloaded videos and MP3. Formats that can't hold a cover (such as WEBM) are still downloaded.

linkAtTime.description: Link panel: option that copies a youtu.be link starting at the current time.

linkMarkdown.description: Link panel: option that copies a Markdown link with the title and time.

linkPlain.description: Link panel: option that copies a youtu.be link without a time.

linkCopied.description: Link panel: shown for about 2 seconds after copying.

linkCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy to the clipboard. Select the text below and copy it yourself.
linkCopyFailed.description: Link panel: error when the browser refuses clipboard access.

helpDarkMode.message: Switch YouTube between the dark and light theme.
helpDarkMode.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Dark mode button.

darkModeUnavailable.message: Can't switch. Please use YouTube's Appearance setting.
darkModeUnavailable.description: Dark mode button: shown briefly when YouTube's Appearance menu could not be found or used (spec 003 FR-15).

helpCinema.message: Dim everything on the page except the player.
helpCinema.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Cinema mode button.

helpPip.message: Play the video in a separate small window.
helpPip.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Picture-in-picture button.

helpFloating.message: Keep the player in a corner of the screen while you scroll down.
helpFloating.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Floating player button.

helpLoop.message: Repeat the whole video or a part of it.
helpLoop.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Loop button.

helpMore.message: More options, such as pausing the video when you switch tabs.
helpMore.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the More button.

helpHelp.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Help button.

helpClose.message: Hide the toolbar. Turn it back on from the extension's popup.
helpClose.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Close button.

helpOpenSettings.description: Help panel: link that opens the extension's settings page.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the extension's settings page.

optionsTidyTitle.description: Settings page: heading of the page tidy section.

optionsTidyDesc.message: Changes to YouTube pages that stay on until you turn them off. They take effect right away in open YouTube tabs, even when the toolbar is closed.
optionsTidyDesc.description: Settings page: one-line explanation under the page tidy heading.

optionsDownloadsTitle.description: Settings page: heading of the downloads section.

tidyOriginalAudioDesc.message: When YouTube plays an automatically dubbed (AI) audio track, switch to the video's original audio.

tidyHideEndCards.message: Hide end cards and the end screen

tidyHideEndCardsDesc.message: Hides the cards shown in the last seconds of a video and the grid of videos after it ends. Autoplay keeps working.

tidyAutoContinueDesc.message: When YouTube pauses the video and asks “Video paused. Continue watching?”, close the dialog and keep playing.

tidyNoThumbnailPreviewDesc.message: Thumbnails stay still when you hover over them instead of playing a preview.

tidyShortsToWatch.message: Open Shorts in the normal player

tidyShortsToWatchDesc.message: Opens Shorts links as a normal watch page with the full player and the toolbar.

tidyHideShortsDesc.message: Hides Shorts on the home page, subscriptions, search results, recommendations and in the side menu.

tidyFullTitlesDesc.message: Shows whole titles in video lists instead of cutting them off with “…”.

pipUnsupported.description: Tooltip reason when the browser has no native picture-in-picture.

floatingDrag.description: Tooltip of the drag handle on the floating player.

floatingClose.message: Return the player to the page
floatingClose.description: Close button on the floating player; the player returns to its place until the next scroll away.

loopModeLabel.description: Accessible label of the loop mode radio group.

loopModeRepeat.description: Loop panel: mode that repeats the whole video N times.

loopTimesLabel.description: Loop panel: accessible label of the number input.

loopTimesUnit.description: Loop panel: unit after the number input.

loopTimesError.description: Loop panel: error for an invalid number of times.

loopModeSegment.description: Loop panel: mode that loops between a start and an end time.

loopPlayedCount.description: Loop panel: how many times the video or segment has been played.

timeStart.description: Label of the start time input and slider handle.

timeEnd.description: Label of the end time input and slider handle.

timeErrorOutOfRange.description: Time input error: later than the end of the video.

timeErrorOrder.description: Time input error: start is not before end.

moreSmartPauseDesc.message: Pauses the video when you switch tabs or minimize the window, and resumes it when you come back.

moreAutoplayDesc.message: The same setting as YouTube's own autoplay switch.

moreAutoplayMissing.message: YouTube's autoplay switch was not found on this page.
moreAutoplayMissing.description: More panel: shown when YouTube's autoplay switch cannot be found.

moreAudioOnlyDesc.message: Shows the thumbnail instead of the picture. It only hides the video and does not save bandwidth.

moreWheelVolumeDesc.message: Scroll over the player to change the volume in 5% steps.

moreHideCommentsDesc.message: Hides the comment section below the video.

moreQualityLockDesc.message: Plays every video in this quality, or the highest lower one when it isn't available.

qualityOff.description: Quality lock option: let YouTube choose the quality.

qualityMax.description: Quality lock option: always use the highest quality of the video.

volumeHint.description: Accessible label of the volume indicator shown over the player.

darkModeUnavailableHint.message: Couldn't find YouTube's Appearance option. If you use an extension that changes the theme (for example, an ambient light extension), set its theme to follow YouTube.
darkModeUnavailableHint.description: Dark mode button: shown for about 6 seconds when YouTube's Appearance menu or option could not be found or used, e.g. because another extension controls the theme (spec 003 FR-15).
